Please review the below NSN and provide DLA with any sources that have the ability to manufacture the items. Please also provide the location of the manufacturer (City and State OR Country if applicable).

NSN: 1005-01-383-0168

Please also provide POCs for these manufacturers if available.  All this information can be submitted to Deonna Coleman at Deonna.Coleman@dla.mil, Phone: 614-852-6446.  Thank you in advance for your assistance.
